name: Corgi FTSE 5–10 Year IG Corporate Bond ETF
name_en: Corgi FTSE 5–10 Year IG Corporate Bond ETF
desc: The fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate bonds of U.S. and foreign issuers with a remaining maturity of at least five years and less than ten years that comprise the index. It is non-diversified.
